proposedBy: Codex, implementing the LLP 0063 Step 4 remediation
ratifier: Charlie Cheever, as named by partitime.comparison-protocol.v1
ratificationStatement: I ratify Exact LLP 0386 §3.8 and the Snapback WS8 web/native invalidations dated 2026-07-22

invalidates.scope: The unpaired native build/profile rule in the 2026-07-21 prospective amendment. No native calibration thresholds or promoted claims exist, so this correction invalidates only the method and its retained diagnostic run.

replacement.candidate: Exact + Contract iOS Release/Simulator carrier loading a production-bundled Hermes HBC artifact
replacement.control: React Expo iOS Release/Simulator carrier loading its release Hermes HBC artifact
replacement.sameHostRule: Candidate and control run on the same host, OS, simulator runtime, simulator device class, and cache protocol.
replacement.observerRule: Acto, debug overlays, Metro/Vite development transforms, and agent-server code are absent before first frame. First frame comes from the native host and first authoritative data comes from a carrier-owned structured product marker whose implementation bytes remain inside the measured artifact.
replacement.assetRule: startupAssetWeightBytes is the HBC actually admitted by the qualifying launch. Development module-table source, debug source fallbacks, native binaries, symbols, and test artifacts are not substituted for that value.
replacement.thresholdPolicy: Calibrate all four thresholds from the paired React Release lane using the already-ratified 1.10 formula, commit the calibration, then execute an independent Exact holdout against that committed revision.

cause.finding: The diagnostic paired a React Expo Release/Simulator app with Exact's Debug host loading a development module-table startup artifact and the eager Acto agent graph. Exact LLP 0145 explicitly says this comparison is a debugging smell, not a headline comparison, and Exact LLP 0128 assigns agent-off startup budgets and agent inspection to separate lanes.
cause.notAProductOptimization: The retained 7.1 MB / 460-module / 6.4 s Exact result remains evidence about the agent-on development carrier. Reclassifying it does not make the release candidate faster, change any threshold formula, discard a valid release sample, or promote a claim.

localCompositionProbe.interpretation: Acto accounts for roughly half the observed development graph, while the remaining agent-off module table is still a development artifact and is not admitted as a release replacement.

rawReceiptsMustAttest: agent not loaded before first frame
